findings.failure_path: Lane 6 is labeled human-authorized solely through the standing instruction recorded in continuation-authorization-3.md, whose future-lane scope is itself described as a controller reading. This conflicts with continuation-authorization-2.md's rule that no controller-side interpretation authorizes a lane, allowing another fix-and-review lane to proceed without evidence of an explicit human grant.
findings.smallest_fix: Attach or cite a verifiable explicit maintainer grant covering lane 6; otherwise mark lane 6 unauthorized and do not use its receipts as human-authorized review evidence.
